name: partner-center-onboarding
description: Self-serve Partner Center onboarding with guidance-only registration, tenant association, account verification, publish-path, and REO/MPO/CSP/Japan-tax triage. Preserves four decision-flow images, a JP tax cheatsheet, and the verification specialist. The separate optional marketplace-publishing skill requires actual runtime tools, human seller-tenant authentication, roles, and submission API access; every change needs its own preview and approval. A connector availability label is not runtime discovery or authentication. When tools are absent, stop as BLOCKED and report only the observed missing-tool symptom, not an assumed auth or seller-rights failure. Portable Agent Skills for GitHub Copilot CLI and Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork. This diagnostic release does not fix or establish the cause of the known Cowork runtime-tool gap.
